Already-braking terminal command: at the same saved state and horizon, the recorded actual_tension_n drives the endpoint tip speed close to the braking-box endpoint (small endpoint speed difference), i.e. the terminal command was near braking-maximal locally and the local input is not the limiting factor at this state.

Position-speed trade rather than pure braking: the two arms differ mainly in endpoint tip position rather than endpoint tip speed (or the opposite), so a local input change trades terminal position error against terminal speed instead of buying additional braking.
